proof: `FY'18 OMNIBUS BUDGET:` as voted at the 2 May 2017 Annual Town Meeting, PDF pages 168-169 of the FY2017 annual town report. THE PAGES CARRY THEIR OWN TEXT LAYER -- pdfplumber returns 476 and 155 words -- so the characters are exact and no digit here can have been misread; the only open question is the document's own arithmetic. THE PRINTED HEADER, on page 168: `LINE # | ACCOUNT | FY18`. Page 168 prints the table in TWO PANELS side by side (x 70-300 and x 310-540) and page 169 in one (x 70-300); each panel is bounded and banded separately, because reading across the page pairs a General Government line with a Protection line. 91 NUMBERED LINE ITEMS, 1 to 82 with letter suffixes 3A 3B 13A 14A 43A 61A 72A 79A 79B, WITH NO GAP IN THE NUMBERING -- which is the check the table supplies about its own completeness. 12 section totals, 6 subtotals, and a printed `Total Omnibus $35,690,393.70`. TEN OF THE TWELVE SECTION TOTALS FOOT THEIR OWN LINE ITEMS TO THE CENT, and Total Protection foots its four subtotals exactly once Subtotal Police is corrected (see below). TWO COLUMNS ARE CHECKED AGAINST THE SAME PRINTED Total Omnibus AND BOTH ARE ATTESTED, in opposite directions, each isolating ONE misprint. (1) The 91 line items sum to $35,690,393.19, exactly $0.51 short, which is the whole of the Total Health & Sanitation over-print: lines 54 to 58 sum to $70,866.44 (33,883.00 + 24,707.95 + 11,275.49 + 0 + 1,000.00) against a printed $70,866.95. (2) The 12 section totals sum to $35,690,392.84, exactly $0.86 short, which is the whole of the Total Public Library under-print: line 82 `Lunenburg Public Library` prints $381,709.86 and the section total below it prints $381,709.00. Total Omnibus agrees with the CORRECTED Library figure to the cent, so the town's own grand total places that error in the printed Total Public Library line. Neither residual can be a reading error: a wrong digit anywhere else would break one of the ten footing sections. WHICH FIGURE IS WRONG IN HEALTH & SANITATION IS NOT ESTABLISHED. The same table is REPRINTED in this report at pages 155-158, inside the Article 8 text, and the reprint prints the identical five lines and the identical $70,866.95 total -- so the two printings agree and the 51 cents is in both. Several single-line corrections would close it and the document does not say which.

The town's own arithmetic. Lines 54-58 print 33,883.00 + 24,707.95 + 11,275.49 + $- + 1,000.00 = 70,866.44 under a printed `Total Health & Sanitation $70,866.95`, 51 cents more. Total Omnibus uses the printed section total, so the 91 line items are 51 cents short of it. The same table reprinted at pp.155-158 prints the identical five lines and the identical total, so both printings carry it. WHICH OF THE SIX FIGURES IS WRONG IS NOT ESTABLISHED.

The town's own arithmetic. Line 82 `Lunenburg Public Library` prints $381,709.86 and the `Total Public Library` row directly beneath it, which has no other component, prints $381,709.00. Total Omnibus $35,690,393.70 agrees with 381,709.86 to the cent, so the grand total used the line and the SECTION TOTAL is the misprint.

A MALFORMED FIGURE PRINTED ON THE PAGE, not an artefact of our reading. Page 168 prints `Subtotal Police  $  1,4633,881.75` -- a four-digit thousands group -- and the reprint at page 156 prints the identical string, so the defect is the document's and is in both printings. The value is established twice over and is $1,633,881.75: its own four lines, 39 Police Department 1,543,198.75 + 40 Police Lock Up 80,060.00 + 41 Injury Leave 5,623.00 + 42 Police/Fire Med Expenses 5,000.00; and `Total Protection $2,941,492.35`, which that figure closes with the other three subtotals (870,622.09 + 255,718.71 + 181,269.80) to the cent. The figure is recorded here at its established value and the page's own string is quoted above, because 1,4633,881.75 parses to 14,633,881.75 and that is not what the page means.
